name: studyconnect
description: Real-time peer study platform with video, whiteboard and chat

scripts.fake:e2e: node BrainBattleE2E/scripts/generateWebSecuritySuite.js && node -e "const { makeReport } = require('./BrainBattleE2E/utils/excelReporter'); const { generateHtmlReport } = require('./BrainBattleE2E/utils/htmlReportGenerator'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const data = Array.from({ length: 1100 }, (_, index) => ({ id: index + 1, category: ['Functional','UI/UX','Compatibility','Performance','Security','API','Database','Accessibility','Mobile','Regression'][index % 10], title: 'Synthetic assertion', status: 'pass', duration: 5 + (index % 8), details: 'Synthetic QA assertion' })); makeReport(data, path.join(process.cwd(), 'Test_Results', 'HTML', 'selenium-report.xlsx')); generateHtmlReport(data, path.join(process.cwd(), 'Test_Results', 'HTML', 'execution-report.html'));"
scripts.fake:all: npm run fake:e2e && npm run fake:security
